name: FiniteRuleAssemblyPause
mechanism_state_change: Hold RULE_ASSEMBLY formation_progress constant for 1200 parameter-update opportunities, then restore the captured learning rates and resume assembly.
operation: At each paused update, zero only current gradients and set each current optimizer-group learning rate to zero. Parameter Results therefore remain fixed while optimizer occurrences and declared data order continue. Restore the captured group learning rates after the finite pause.
